script_text: ARIES — Mars, your ruling planet, ignites a volatile week where a square to Saturn demands you slow down before charging forward. Early week, Mercury trines Jupiter in your 9th House, making Wednesday ideal for signing contracts or launching travel plans. But Monday carries tension if you act recklessly, so pause before committing. Midweek, Venus enters your 5th House, the love and creativity sector, bringing a romantic encounter that rewires your emotional world entirely. Late week, the Sun conjoins Mars in your 1st House, fueling your confidence and spotlighting bold career moves that earn public recognition. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, sparking passion and fresh inspiration. Thursday is your worst day because the Moon squares Mars, stirring impulsive arguments you cannot afford. Your weekly advice: channel your fire element into one focused goal rather than scattering your energy across every battle. Follow for daily updates.
